CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles(id,full_name,role)
  values (new.id, coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name', split_part(new.email,'@',1)), 'staff')
  on conflict (id) do nothing;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles
    where id = auth.uid() and role = 'admin' and active = true
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.menu_item_can_sell(p_menu_item uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 select coalesce((select mi.active and not mi.manual_unavailable from public.menu_items mi where mi.id=p_menu_item),false)
 and not exists (
   select 1 from public.recipes r join public.inventory_items ii on ii.id=r.inventory_item_id
   where r.menu_item_id=p_menu_item
   and (not ii.active or ii.manual_unavailable or ii.current_stock < r.quantity_required)
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recalc_order_total(p_order uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 update public.orders o set total=coalesce((select sum(oi.unit_price*oi.quantity) from public.order_items oi where oi.order_id=p_order),0),updated_at=now()
 where o.id=p_order and (public.is_admin() or public.is_cashier() or o.created_by=auth.uid() or o.assigned_to=auth.uid());
$function$

views.name: product_profitability
views.sql:
SELECT mi.id AS menu_item_id,
    mi.name,
    mi.business,
    mi.price AS sale_price,
    mi.unit_cost,
    (mi.price - mi.unit_cost) AS unit_profit,
        CASE
            WHEN (mi.price > (0)::numeric) THEN round((((mi.price - mi.unit_cost) / mi.price) * (100)::numeric), 2)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END AS margin_pct,
    COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (o.status = 'closed'::text) THEN oi.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END), (0)::bigint) AS units_sold,
    (COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (o.status = 'closed'::text) THEN oi.line_total
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric))::numeric(12,2) AS revenue,
    (COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (o.status = 'closed'::text) THEN ((oi.quantity)::numeric * mi.unit_cost)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric))::numeric(12,2) AS product_cost,
    (COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (o.status = 'closed'::text) THEN (oi.line_total - ((oi.quantity)::numeric * mi.unit_cost))
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric))::numeric(12,2) AS gross_profit
   FROM ((menu_items mi
     LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON ((oi.menu_item_id = mi.id)))
     LEFT JOIN orders o ON ((o.id = oi.order_id)))
  GROUP BY mi.id, mi.name, mi.business, mi.price, mi.unit_cost;

SELECT id,
    business,
    name,
    category,
    unit,
    current_stock,
    minimum_stock,
    unit_cost,
    active,
    updated_at,
    base_unit,
    display_unit,
    quantity_per_display_unit,
    manual_unavailable,
        CASE
            WHEN manual_unavailable THEN 'No disponible'::text
            WHEN (current_stock <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'Agotado'::text
            WHEN (current_stock <= minimum_stock) THEN 'Existencia baja'::text
            ELSE 'Disponible'::text
        END AS stock_status
   FROM inventory_items ii;

views.name: v_order_business_split
views.sql:
WITH gross AS (
         SELECT o.id AS order_id,
            o.business_date,
            o.status,
            o.payment_method,
            o.total AS charged_total,
            oi.business,
            sum((oi.unit_price * (oi.quantity)::numeric)) AS gross_business
           FROM (orders o
             JOIN order_items oi ON ((oi.order_id = o.id)))
          GROUP BY o.id, o.business_date, o.status, o.payment_method, o.total, oi.business
        ), allocated AS (
         SELECT g.order_id,
            g.business_date,
            g.status,
            g.payment_method,
            g.charged_total,
            g.business,
            g.gross_business,
            sum(g.gross_business) OVER (PARTITION BY g.order_id) AS gross_order,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY g.order_id ORDER BY g.business) AS rn,
            count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY g.order_id) AS n
           FROM gross g
        ), split AS (
         SELECT a.order_id,
            a.business_date,
            a.status,
            a.payment_method,
            a.charged_total,
            a.business,
            a.gross_business,
            a.gross_order,
            a.rn,
            a.n,
                CASE
                    WHEN (a.gross_order > (0)::numeric) THEN round(((a.charged_total * a.gross_business) / a.gross_order), 2)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS preliminary_share
           FROM allocated a
        )
 SELECT order_id,
    business_date,
    status,
    payment_method,
    business,
    gross_business,
        CASE
            WHEN (rn = n) THEN (charged_total - COALESCE(( SELECT sum(t.preliminary_share) AS sum
               FROM split t
              WHERE ((t.order_id = s.order_id) AND (t.rn < t.n))), (0)::numeric))
            ELSE preliminary_share
        END AS net_business,
    charged_total AS total_customer_account
   FROM split s;
